T1 is a long investigation: the supplemental-refund request for ORD-9497C0 forces the agent to trace the order across skill domains (its customer sits in state-shopping but returns live in state-customer-support) before it can act. T2/T7 pull customer profiles, T3 adds a contact, T4 searches contacts and recaps the refund, T5 books Sofia's flight only after heavily patching the airline skill's own data model, T6/T9 show airline profiles, T8 books a hotel, T10 validates an (expired) promo, and T11 creates a reminder while recalling the earlier flight/fare. The recall probes (T4, T9, T10, T11) are almost all credited — the agent tracks entities across five skills and multiple users without re-asking.
